reporting-org.narrative: FMO NV (Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V.)

description.narrative: FMO’s loan of EUR 6.97 million will catalyse EUR 7.90 million from ICCF both for a 14-year tenor and mobilise a further EUR 6.16 million from AEF which will have a longer 20-year tenor. This financing will allow for the development, construction, operation and maintenance of a 30MWp solar farm with a total project cost of EUR 27.11 million.
